The 2026 Honda Ridgeline TrailSport in Silver delivers premium truck capability with refined comfort and advanced technology. This new Crew Cab Short Box model features a 3.5L V6 engine paired with a 9-Speed Automatic transmission and all-wheel drive for confident handling in any condition. Visit us today to experience the reliability and refinement that makes the Pilot the benchmark for midsize family SUVs.
